items.word: The hero vowed to smite his enemies.
items.definition:
smite
To strike with a firm blow; to affect suddenly and powerfully

items.word: Many immigrants were indentured servants in the colonies.
items.definition:
indenture
To bind someone by an agreement as an apprentice or laborer

items.word: The strong winds threatened to rive the old flag.
items.definition:
rive
to tear apart or split

items.word: The old train began to chuff slowly out of the station.
items.definition:
chuff
To make a regular puffing sound, like a steam engine.

items.word: The team's logo was emblazoned on their new jerseys.
items.definition:
emblazon
to inscribe or display a design on something

items.word: Her wit and charm scintillated throughout the evening.
items.definition:
scintillate
to sparkle; to emit flashes of light; to be brilliant and exciting

items.word: The blacksmith will anneal the steel to reduce its brittleness.
items.definition:
anneal
to heat and then slowly cool (metal or glass) to toughen it
